class ComputedCall {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { receiver?.[this.value = 1](); }
}
class ComputedRead {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { console.log(receiver?.[this.value = 2]); }
}
class ContinuingChain {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { receiver?.method![this.value = 3](); }
}
class NestedOptional {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { (receiver?.method)?.[this.value = 4](); }
}
new ComputedCall(null).value.toFixed();
new ComputedRead(null).value.toFixed();
new ContinuingChain(null).value.toFixed();
new NestedOptional(null).value.toFixed();
class ChainBreak {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { (receiver?.method)(this.value = 5); }
}
class Conditional {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) {
    if (receiver?.[this.value = 6]) {}
    else this.value = 7;
  }
}
class Coalescing {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { (receiver?.[this.value = 8]) ?? (this.value = 9); }
}
class Immediate {
  value;
  constructor() { (() => { this.value = 10; })?.(); }
}
class Negation {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { if (!(receiver?.[this.value = 11])) this.value = 12; }
}
class DoubleNegation {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) {
    if (!!receiver?.[this.value = 13]) {}
    else this.value = 14;
  }
}
class NegatedLogical {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: any) { if (!(receiver?.[this.value = 15] && receiver.ready)) this.value = 16; }
}
function controls(receiver: any) {
  return [
    new ChainBreak(receiver).value.toFixed(),
    new Conditional(receiver).value.toFixed(),
    new Coalescing(receiver).value.toFixed(),
    new Immediate().value.toFixed(),
    new Negation(receiver).value.toFixed(),
    new DoubleNegation(receiver).value.toFixed(),
    new NegatedLogical(receiver).value.toFixed(),
  ];
}
